nodes.title: How to use - tested on RTX 3060
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

1. Load a **driving video** (the motion) and a **character image** (who should move like that).
2. **Pick a MODE**:

| Mode | Model | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Wan Animate 2 (12 GB, int8, native) | Wan Animate 2 distilled int8 | core nodes only |
| Wan 2.2 Animate GGUF (low VRAM) | Wan 2.2 Animate 14B GGUF + relight + lightx2v LoRAs, 4 steps | ComfyUI-GGUF |

3. Describe the character + background, press **Run**. You get the result and an original | result side-by-side.

Times on the RTX 3060 are in the repo README.
